other_conditions: Applicant must hold a minimum graduate degree in engineering or an equivalent qualification
Must have at least ten (10) years of industry experience
Must have distinguished work experience evidenced by development of products, technology, processes, patents, publications, awards, etc.
All retired INAE Fellows are also eligible to apply
For exceptional cases the Selection Committee may relax the age limits
benefits_summary: Honorarium of ₹10,000 per lecture day with travel reimbursement (air‑fare, rail or road) as applicable.
documents_required: Copy of AICTE letter of approval
